SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Alright, I'll see you tomorrow then, at the usual 
spot in the school cafeteria.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Ah, Kyou-chan. Do you want some tea before you 
go?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I always end up having tea after escorting you 
home, so I'll pass this time.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
But, but... Grandpa and Grandma and Dad and Mom 
would be happy to see you, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: *stare*

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Haa...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, just for a while then.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...Okay!

I knew my way around here, so I went straight to 
the living room upon entering.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I have no sense of restraint, even if I say so myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
There's some steamed buns, so feel free to have 
some.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Thanks. Huh? These buns...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
New products that we'll be selling soon. How are 
they?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I figured as much. These are really good. Your 
father is amazing, as expected.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Huh? You're exaggerating～

The steam probably fogged up her glasses, since 
she took them off to wipe while she replied.

Sometimes I wonder... no really, but she does look 
rather adorable without her glasses.

Well, such occasions are rare since she can barely 
see anything without them.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT: Ooh, Kyou-chan. It's been a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: "It's been a while"? It's only been like a week.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
No need to take this so seriously, it's just a casual 
greeting. I've still got a long way to go before I'm 
senile. Hahahaha!

Laughing so heartily, he sure is energetic. This old 
geezer could probably live for about two hundred 
years, I bet.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Where do you get your vitality from, Grandpa?

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
Oh, I'm still in the game, Kyou-chan. I wouldn't even 
lose to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I appreciate the enthusiasm, but you really should 
consider your age.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT: So, how far have you gone with Manami? Hmm?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Wha-? I'm pretty sure you ask that whenever we 
meet? It's not like it's your business anyway...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: We went to Odaiba today.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
Manami, I didn't ask about a location. I'm talking 
about... you know... between a man and a woman.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: H-Huh?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=28]Hey Gramps, that’s not something that 
you should be asking![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: See! You're just making things awkward for her!

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
What? You two are still in the "platonic" phase?  
Well, that's boring. I would like to see my 
great-grandchild’s face soon.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Just how impatient are you? Especially at your age.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT: No need to get upset, Kyou-chan. Fufufufufu...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
What's with that laugh? You're not thinking of 
anything bad, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT: No, no, absolutely not.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Grandpa, you sure are enjoying yourself more than 
usual today. Are you happy?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Definitely, he is more giggly than usual. This 
happens when the store earns 20% extra profit.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
Hmph, so you figured it out? And I tried so hard to 
keep it hidden...

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
Fufufufu, well actually, there's something I'd like to 
show you both.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: What? What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So, what is it, Gramps?

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT: Haaah, whatever should I do...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Stop acting so smug. If you keep us in suspense 
like that, then we HAVE to see it!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Yeah. Come on, Grandpa.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
No, well, you see, I have to ham it up for something 
so good. Otherwise, you won't appreciate it.
*sigh*... Well, guess we'll have to play along.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Gramps, I'm begging you, just show it to us 
already.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT: No matter what?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No matter what!
Ugh! Seriously, this old fart is such a pain!

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT: Mmm, okay then...

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
Ta-dah~~! I won a three-day, two-night trip to 
Kyoto for two from the town lottery!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Wow! That's amazing, Grandpa!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You have some absurd luck, Gramps!

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
Hahaha. It's because of my little daily routines. Even 
God understands...
Man... I sure want to be a smart-ass right now...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, this is great, Gramps. Hey, why don't you go 
on the trip with Granny, then?

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT: No, no, I had that idea, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
If I were to go on this kind of trip, it'd be better to 
be accompanied by a lively gal instead.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hey now, if Granny hears you, she’ll pull out what's 
left of your hair.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT: That wouldn't end well. So then, I thought about it...

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT: I'll just give this prize to you two.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Eh?!
Whoa, that sure is generous of him...

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
It's almost your summer vacation, right? It'll be a 
pleasant memory for me in the afterlife.
Hey old geezer. Don't say stuff like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Are you sure, Grandpa?

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
I don't mind. I got it by pure chance anyway... 
Besides, this is so I can see my great-grandchild 
sooner.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Thank you, Grandpa!

Hey, Miss Manami. Are you just going to ignore that 
ridiculous statement?

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
Well, we are too old for long trips. Our bodies can’t 
take it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You sure don't look that way to me...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Kyou-chan, Kyou-chan, it’s a vacation! A three-day, 
two-night vacation!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah. We haven't been to Kyoto since our school 
trip.

Speaking of which, we went to Kiyomizu temple 
that time, too.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [font_size=19]And this time, it's just the two of us...[/font_size]

Do you realize what you're saying, Manami? Can I 
treat this as a flag?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah... just the two of us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey! Are you okay with this, Gramps!

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
Of course. Don't you worry about a thing, just 
enjoy yourselves to the fullest.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Yup. We'll bring back lots of souvenirs~

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I hope we have a great vacation, Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Manami's old-hag personality and Kyoto. What a 
nice combination.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
What did you say~? That's not very nice, 
Kyou-chan.

Even though I'm just teasing her as usual... Crap, 
my heart is beating so fast.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Since we're going on a vacation, maybe I should 
put more effort in dressing myself up?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hm? I think you're pretty just the way you are, 
though?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: But, sometimes I just want to know your opinion.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If you think it'll help, then sure...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: So...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Like, for example, what if I just started using 
contacts all the time?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I don't think you have to force yourself, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Eh? But... but... I'll be able to see even better 
compared to my glasses.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You gotta put them directly onto your eyes, you 
know? You're not used to it, yet you're gonna wear 
them on vacation?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I guess... it wouldn't work.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
If that's the case, you should just stick to your 
glasses.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Speaking of which, you really like girls with glasses, 
huh? All your dirty magazines have them.
WHA--!! She even remembers that?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
That was a misunderstanding... no need to bring that 
up, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I’d be just happy to fit your "type", I guess.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan... you're not... embarrassed, are you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, I'm not...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Fufufu...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Should I try to use contact lenses?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
That doesn't sound bad. I wanna see you without 
glasses too.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Really? But... don't you like girls with glasses more?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh? What do you mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Well, all the girls in your dirty magazines wore 
them.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You sure remember some ancient stuff, huh?!
Just forget them! Please forget them immediately!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Hmm, I see. Well, I'll put in contacts for our trip, so 
look forward to it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-Sure...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Which do you like better, me with glasses, or 
without?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Umm, well... if I must answer... I guess I like them 
both.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan, y-your honesty is just...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Anyway, why don't you just be your usual self?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...Yeah, okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Mmm.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
Heh heh heh, what an interesting development. I'm 
looking forward to this...

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT: It's time to pay the piper, Kyou-chan――
